comment: WHAT DEPLOYS, declared rather than inferred.
The tools exist twice: tracked here, and copied to <workspace>/tools where
agents actually run them. Nothing recorded which commit the copy came from,
so 'is the deployment current?' could only be answered by hashing every file
by hand - which is how the 2026-09-22 drift was found, after the fact.
There is no rule to infer. MOVE-TOOLS-IN.ps1 chose seven families by hand in
September ('the tools the doc set and agent definitions actually cite') and
left four tracked families behind. tests/ deploys inside some families and
not others. So the set is declared here, reviewably, and deploy_tools.py
reads it. This file plus DEPLOYED.json is the whole mechanism.
ADDING AN ENTRY IS A DEPLOYMENT DECISION. The closure family below is not
yet deployed anywhere; it is declared because CLOSURE_PROTOCOL_CUTOVER.md
already specifies it as the supported set, and prose that nothing executes
is how the previous deployment went stale unnoticed. --check reports a
declared-but-absent file as 'absent', which is a true statement about today

codex-jobs.note: Not deployed today. Required by CLOSURE_PROTOCOL_CUTOVER.md: the closure launcher and its prompt template.

root_files_note: NEITHER IS DEPLOYED TODAY, and the closure launcher refuses without them.
exits 2 when it is missing; make_closure_prompt.py imports it from its
parent directory. review_result.py is the protocol every reader goes
through. Deploying codex-jobs or the jobs checkers without these two gives
a launcher that refuses every run.

never_deploy.ger-contract-revisions-20260916: a verbatim archive, and the GER Agent's live working area
never_deploy.tests: host-level test suites; they run from a checkout, never from a deployment
never_deploy.run_tool_tests.py: runs the suites, which are not deployed
never_deploy.<family>/tests: a deployment is what RUNS; the suites run from a checkout, which is why run_tool_tests.py is never deployed. 15 test files ARE deployed today under art, astra, cleanup and jobs; they report as `extra`, which is a true statement about the deployment and somebody's call to act on.
